notes: This is the committed reference manifest with Pixabay source pages for provenance.
Copy this file to media_sources.json (which is gitignored) and fill in CURRENT direct download URLs.
Pixabay direct CDN links (https://cdn.pixabay.com/audio/...) are the most reliable.
How to get a working direct URL (takes ~20 seconds per file):
1. Open the source_page URL in a browser.
2. Click the play button or the Download button.
3. Open DevTools (F12) → Network tab → filter by 'audio' or '.mp3'.
4. Right-click the request to cdn.pixabay.com → Copy → Copy link address.
5. Paste that full URL into the 'url' field below.
These links usually work without login and are covered by the Pixabay license.
Links can be time-limited; repeat the process if a download fails later.
Only the 'filename' and 'url' fields are required by scripts/fetch_media.py.
Keep the source_page + creator/license fields for your own MEDIA_LICENSES.md audit trail.
